text: Submit an owned application with title, positive amount no greater than 100000 cents and an accessible supporting-document reference.
criteria: Submit a valid application; missing evidence, another applicant's document or amount 100001 is rejected.

text: Only the active assigned reviewer can decide; applicants cannot review their own application.
criteria: Applicant/self-reviewer or an unassigned reviewer attempts approval: denied with no accepted decision.

text: Record one accepted decision per assignment with reason; repeated completion is harmless and stale assignment completion conflicts.
criteria: Submit the same decision twice, then a conflicting/stale completion: one decision persists and the conflict is explicit.

text: Clarification closes the current assignment; resubmission creates a new review opportunity without losing history.
criteria: Request clarification and resubmit; old assignment cannot decide the new review and its history remains visible.

text: After 48 hours without completion, escalate to the coordinator; an already completed review must not be escalated as outstanding.
criteria: Complete just before the escalation worker commits; atomic recheck prevents an outstanding escalation for the completed assignment.

text: For 100 cases and 10 reviewers, satisfy the shared metadata target and reconstruct every accepted decision's actor/assignment/evidence.
criteria: Load the 100-case fixture and reconstruct sampled decisions and metadata latency with raw evidence.
